doctorSignIn.body: Identify yourself to access the patient queue, triage telemetry and clinical notes. No password in this build - this tags the notes you write, and the session ends when you close the app.
doctorSignIn.name: Full Practitioner Name
doctorSignIn.nameHint: As inscribed in the State or National Medical Register.

search.help2: Patients who only ever phoned the voice agent also have an ID; it is read out to them at the end of the call.
